instructions: Add only reviewed status and evidence overrides. The generated completion ledger joins the 76-record preserved baseline with every registered new capability, and the verifier rejects missing coverage or false completion.

purpose.rationale: The user job and curriculum-spine outcome are frozen independently of implementation breadth.

placement.rationale: Course hierarchy is one earned Academy Path workflow rather than a new module grid or imported sub-brand.

workflow.rationale: Synthetic Home-to-Course-to-Session navigation and return plus deterministic scoped EN/FA catalog search are implemented; rights-cleared real-catalog scale, offline-pack states, and prescription breadth remain open.

data_plane.rationale: Stable package hierarchy, exact declared playback ownership, release-bound learner state, checkpoint v1-to-v2 migration, precomputed scoped indexes, independent two-budget LRU, single-flight, per-release/global/active-lookup invalidation, activation recheck, and receipt-backed package recovery exist; signed release trust, on-disk/offline-pack indexes, sync, backup, and observability remain open.

security_privacy.rationale: Only validated package projections render; transport/canonical hashes, canonical stored bytes, record/receipt audit, explicit restore, and Preview/Learner fault isolation are enforced locally. The fixture is non-medical/dev-only; signed release-channel authentication, production storage, privacy lifecycle, and server proof remain open.

evidence: test:Academy keeps Persian chrome, RTL direction, and package content together
localization_rtl.rationale: Representative package hierarchy/chrome pass in English/Persian RTL and the catalog has deterministic Persian normalization plus cross-locale/scoped search; app-wide catalog, font, bidi, transliteration/aliases, and review gates remain open.

evidence: test:Academy remains layout-safe with Persian at 200 percent text scale
accessibility.rationale: Semantics, tooltip-preserving compact status, and 200 percent text are covered; keyboard and screen-reader task proof remain open.

responsive_input.rationale: Compact, medium, and wide geometry plus pointer runtime are exercised; live compact capture and all input modes remain open.

motion_feedback.rationale: Reduced-animation/static mascot fallback is wired; full authored Path choreography and profiler evidence are not implemented.

performance.rationale: Precomputed normalization, independent release/node cache budgets, LRU eviction, oversized bypass, single-flight, active-lookup/per-release invalidation, and activation-race tests exist; full-catalog latency/heap and physical-device profiling remain open.

state_completeness.rationale: No-package, populated, unavailable, failure/retry, success, offline-ready package, corrupt/drifted restore, receipt-chain failure, target-isolated damage, derived-cache eviction/rebuild, active-lookup invalidation, and activation-race states exist; stale sync, permission, conflict, and broad recovery states remain incomplete.

evidence: runtime:English and Persian Night Shift Web flows 2026-07-18
visual_craft.rationale: Real Web rendering matches the selected Night Shift/LUMA direction; typography, compact real-host, full state matrix, and platform critique remain open.

adversarial_quality.rationale: Perfect/Modernize review found and fixed compact overflow, unbounded rail height, duplicate completion semantics, mixed Persian fixture labels, undeclared playback injection, false idempotency, receipt/control-plane gaps, and clear/evict/activation cache races; a full Critics gate remains open.

verification.rationale: Targeted analysis, catalog/progress repositories, widget/geometry, and EN/FA Web runtime evidence pass; real-scale profiling, native accessibility/platform, and production-content proof remain open.
